notes: Assignment scope: vault-side recon only — record .obsidian/ CLI/API surface and enabled core plugins. Done, plus the minimum host-side measurements required to say whether a CLI surface is actually active.

The vault itself contains NO CLI/API config surface. The 'cli': true flag lives in the host app config (~/.config/obsidian/obsidian.json), not the vault; and it is contradicted by the measured absence of every registration artifact (shim, socket, obsidian-cli payload). Treat it as a persisted preference, not evidence of a working CLI.

The verified fallback is direct sha256sum under the vault path (read-only), which this seat confirmed stable. Mark any CLI-assisted claim NOT-VERIFIED until the operator installs a supported build (tarball/AppImage with an obsidian-named binary) or the packaging ships obsidian-cli next to the electron binary.
